package: @astryxdesign/core

# DragToSnapPointsCard - A playing card that a sideways drag moves between three places: a slow release settles on the nearest, a quick flick carries to the next, and a release moving back returns where it started. Buttons settle it from the keyboard, and the new place is announced. Built only on the public useDragToSnapPoints hook.
# Components: Card, VisuallyHidden

<VStack gap={4}>
  <Text />
  <HStack gap={2}>
    <Card width={96}>
      <VStack gap={1}>
        <Text />
        <Text />
      </VStack>
    </Card>
  </HStack>
  <HStack gap={2}>
    <Button variant={index === place ? 'primary' : 'secondary'} />
  </HStack>
  <VisuallyHidden />
</VStack>
